zh.d:
本版让知识库真正成为你的资料库：文档可以在目录旁直接打开、编辑并自动保存，Word、Excel、PPT、PDF 原件无需联网就能预览和修改，检索自带本地向量模型、开箱即用；自动化则能一键套用模板，并把结果推送到你自己的聊天机器人。dream 引擎与内置模型依旧开箱即用，无需注册、无需粘贴 Key。

【新增】
· 【知识库目录】内置资料库支持多级目录，点开文档直接显示在目录右侧；富文本文档编辑时自动保存，切换目录或离开前会保护未保存的修改
· 【原文档】可在浏览器内导入原始文档并建立索引；Office 原件在本机离线预览，HTML 在隔离环境中预览，替换原文件后索引同步更新
· 【PDF 阅读】改用内置 pdf.js 渲染，翻页、适应宽度、缩放全部中文，不再露出浏览器插件的英文工具栏
· 【离线 Office 编辑】Word、Excel、PPT 原件先以只读方式打开，点「编辑」切换为可编辑并自动保存；顶部提供中文快捷工具栏（撤销、重做、加粗、斜体、下划线、保存）
· 【表格在线编辑】表格原件新增「在线编辑」，以网格形式修改（前 200 行 × 26 列），保存后写回原 xlsx；原有公式在被编辑的单元格中会替换为数值
· 【本地向量模型】知识库默认使用随安装包附带的本地嵌入模型建立语义索引，无需任何配置（Intel 芯片的 Mac 暂不支持，可改配远程嵌入端点）
· 【内置使用指南】知识库自带使用指南文档，打开即可了解各项功能
· 【搜索】知识库搜索覆盖文档正文，命中文档标题加粗突出，结果页只保留可阅读的结果
· 【自动化模板】自动化面板可从模板添加任务，推荐模板直接展示在面板上
· 【推送到机器人】自动化的运行结果可推送到你自己的聊天机器人（微信、Telegram 等）；已授权的用户无需先聊一句也能选为推送目标
· 【行内快捷操作】自动化列表每一行新增编辑、删除快捷按钮
· 【PPT 制作】内置 ppt-studio 演示文稿引擎，新建 PPT 默认使用它，技能中心的 Office 分类中可以看到
· 【知识库入口】主侧边栏新增知识库入口
· 【多语言】德语、西班牙语、波斯语、法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语、俄语、土耳其语、乌克兰语各补齐约 1230 条此前回退为英文的文案，繁体中文同步补全

【优化改进】
· 【自动化】「定时任务」统一更名为「自动化」；MCP 入口移入设置
· 【侧边栏】新建对话、团队入口换成图标芯片，各历史分组有了独立标题，尺寸与间距统一
· 【首页】输入框静止时更高，场景对话打开时会先打招呼
· 【深色模式】渠道配置表单、文件保险柜上传区、知识库阅读器按钮、场景里的「添加」按钮在深色下配色修正；「转为技能」标题改为绿色
· 【机器人】机器人未选默认模型时，会明确提示先到机器人设置里选择默认模型
· 【MCP 工具名】MCP 工具名统一转换为各模型渠道都接受的安全格式，减少因工具名不合规被模型渠道拒绝的情况

【修复】
· 修复自动化定时运行时不知道今天的日期，导致让它采集「最热门单词」却推送了往年的内容；运行时现在会告知当天日期，并知道结果会自动推送给你，不再反过来问你是否要推送到企业微信
· 修复知识库保存后检索仍命中旧内容、替换原文件后旧检索结果没有失效的问题
· 修复知识库保存状态显示不准、切换目录时未保存的编辑被丢弃
· 修复本地向量模型首次启用时，模型缓存初始化依赖符号链接、在部分环境下失败的问题
· 修复文档页隐藏后 Office 引擎视图仍残留在界面上
· 修复多文件夹项目点「初始化版本控制」时直接弹出 invalid_params 原始报错；现在单根目录自动选定，多根目录给出选择器，找不到可用目录时隐藏按钮
· 修复 ppt-studio 在较弱模型输出下容易出错的问题
· 修复部分开发环境因终端安全软件导致 Chromium 沙箱崩溃、应用无法启动的问题（仅开发环境，安装包不受影响）

本版把企业版的「场景」与「数字员工」推到成员手边：场景向所有成员开放，先问清需求再动手；成员可以直接与公司下发的数字员工开聊；知识库与企业共享目录对齐，内网环境也能在线查看、编辑 Office 原件。部分能力需要企业服务器同步升级后生效。

【新增】
· 【场景】场景向所有成员开放，成为一个「先问再做」的入口：可带提示词、告知所授予的技能与 MCP，并能把粗略需求整理成可执行的需求；成员可开关、拖动排序场景，管理员可编辑数字员工模板
· 【首页场景卡片】场景以一行小卡片展示（头像、名称、授予的技能和工具数量），一行四个，其余收起在「显示全部」；说明与岗位职责悬停可见
· 【数字员工】成员在本机直接与公司下发的数字员工对话，其人设、绑定的技能与连接器自动加载；可给员工布置任务并无人值守定时运行
· 【共享目录】内置资料库与企业共享目录对齐，支持私有、共享的多级目录；成员可上传、编辑、删除自己的知识库文档，管理员下发的文档只读，不可编辑或删除
· 【内网 Office】内网环境中 Office 原件通过企业服务器会话打开：先以查看模式进入，点「编辑」后重新初始化为可编辑；编辑器语言跟随界面语言
· 【来源标识】企业下发的技能、MCP、知识库文档统一以绿色标识
· 【目录身份准入】企业服务端可启用公司目录身份准入闸门，只放行目录内的成员
· 【企业微信机器人】支持保存企业微信机器人适配，并补全钉钉、企业微信 SSO 的个人资料字段

【优化改进】
· 【SSO】桌面端登录只使用 dream 桌面协议
· 【SSO】钉钉授权补充读取用户资料所需权限，并兼容钉钉的双授权码；企业微信浏览器扫码登录走专用路径

【修复】
· 修复流式回复在客户端提前断开时用量没有计入计费的问题
· 修复场景列表返回非列表数据时界面报错，现在按没有场景处理
· 修复场景里「添加一行」按钮没有底色、看不出可点击

en.d:
This release makes the knowledge base a real library of your own: documents open beside the directory, edit with autosave, and Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF originals preview and edit offline, with a bundled local embedding model for search that works out of the box. Automations can now start from a template and push their results to your own chat bot. The dream engine and built-in models still work out of the box, no sign-up and no API key needed.

[New]
· [Library directories] The built-in library supports nested directories; opening a document shows it beside the directory. Rich documents autosave, and unsaved edits are protected when you switch directories or leave
· [Original files] Import original documents in the browser and index them; Office originals preview offline on your machine, HTML previews in an isolated sandbox, and replacing an original refreshes its index
· [PDF reader] PDFs now render with the bundled pdf.js, with page navigation, fit-width and zoom in your language instead of the browser plugin's English toolbar
· [Offline Office editing] Word, Excel and PowerPoint originals open read-only first; click Edit to make them editable with autosave. A localized quick toolbar offers undo, redo, bold, italic, underline and save
· [Spreadsheet editing] Spreadsheet originals gain an online grid editor (first 200 rows by 26 columns) that saves back to the original xlsx; formulas in edited cells are replaced by their values
· [Local embedding model] The knowledge base indexes with a local embedding model bundled in the installer, no configuration needed (not available on Intel Macs; configure a remote embedding endpoint there)
· [Built-in guides] The knowledge base ships with usage guides you can open right away
· [Search] Search covers document content, highlights matching titles, and keeps the results page to readable hits
· [Automation templates] Add an automation from a template; featured templates appear right on the automations panel
· [Push to your bot] An automation can push its finished result to your own chat bot (WeChat, Telegram and more); authorized users can be picked as targets before they have chatted
· [Row shortcuts] Each automation row gets edit and delete shortcuts
· [Presentations] The built-in ppt-studio deck engine is now the default for new decks and appears under Office in the skills hub
· [Knowledge base entry] A knowledge base entry in the main sidebar
· [Languages] German, Spanish, Persian, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Ukrainian each gain about 1,230 strings that used to fall back to English; Traditional Chinese is completed

[Improved]
· [Automations] Scheduled tasks are now called Automations; the MCP entry moves into Settings
· [Sidebar] New chat and Team entries get icon chips, each history section has its own label, and sizes and spacing are consistent
· [Home] The composer is taller at rest, and a scene's conversation greets you first
· [Dark mode] Channel setup forms, the file vault upload area, knowledge reader buttons and the scene add buttons now read correctly in dark; the Turn into skill title is green
· [Bots] A bot without a default model now tells you to pick one in the bot settings
· [MCP tool names] MCP tool names are converted to a form every model provider accepts, reducing rejections caused by invalid names

[Fixed]
· Scheduled automations did not know today's date, so a request for the hottest English words could push content from years ago; runs now know the current date and that the result is delivered automatically, instead of asking whether to push to WeCom
· Knowledge base search could return stale content after saving, and replacing an original did not invalidate old results
· Wrong saved-state display in the knowledge base, and unsaved edits being lost when switching directories
· First use of the local embedding model could fail in environments where its model cache relied on symlinks
· The Office engine view could linger on screen after its page was hidden
· Initializing version control on a multi-folder project showed the raw invalid_params error; a single root is now picked automatically, several roots offer a picker, and the button hides when no folder is reachable
· ppt-studio is more robust against weaker model output
· Dev-only: the app could not boot on hosts where endpoint security software breaks Chromium's sandbox (installed builds are unaffected)

This release puts enterprise scenes and digital employees within every member's reach: scenes open to everyone and ask before they build, members can chat with the digital employees their company issued, and the knowledge base lines up with shared company directories, with Office originals viewable and editable even on an intranet. Some capabilities need the enterprise server upgraded alongside.

[New]
· [Scenes] Scenes are open to all members as an ask-first entry point: they can carry a prompt, tell members which skills and MCP they grant, and turn a rough request into an actionable one. Members can switch scenes on or off and reorder them; admins can edit digital employee templates
· [Home scene cards] Scenes show as one-line cards (avatar, name, how many skills and tools they hand over), four to a row with the rest behind Show all; the description and job functions appear on hover
· [Digital employees] Members chat with company-issued digital employees on their own machine, loading the employee's persona, bound skills and connectors; employees can be given a task and scheduled to run unattended
· [Shared directories] The built-in library lines up with enterprise directories, private and shared, nested; members can add, edit and delete their own documents, while documents issued by an admin are read-only
· [Intranet Office] On an intranet, Office originals open through an enterprise server session: viewer first, then re-initialized as editable when you click Edit, with the editor language following the app locale
· [Origin marks] Company-issued skills, MCP servers and knowledge documents are marked in green
· [Directory admission] The enterprise server can enable an optional company directory identity admission gate
· [WeCom bot] Saving a WeCom bot adapter is supported, and DingTalk and WeCom SSO profiles are enriched

[Improved]
· [SSO] Desktop sign-in uses only the dream desktop protocols
· [SSO] DingTalk authorization now requests the scope needed to read user profiles and accepts DingTalk's dual codes; WeCom browser QR login uses a dedicated path

[Fixed]
· Usage was not metered when a client disconnected before a streamed reply finished
· The UI errored when the scenes answer was not a list; it is now treated as no scenes
· The add-a-line buttons in scenes had no background and did not read as buttons
